curriculum.subject: Mathematical Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: appreciate activities that are done on different days of the week.

mission.title: appreciate activities that are done on different days of the week.

interactions.prompt: Amina goes to school on Monday. She plays at home on Saturday. Are these activities on different days?
interactions.feedback: Yes! School and home play can happen on different days.
interactions.retryHint: Look at the two day names: Monday and Saturday are not the same.

interactions.prompt: Look at this plan: Tuesday is reading day. Friday is games day. Which activity is on Friday?
interactions.feedback: Good looking! Friday is games day in this plan.
interactions.retryHint: Point to Friday, then read the activity beside it.

interactions.prompt: Put the activity card on its day. Tap Wednesday, then tap art time.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap Wednesday, then tap art time to make the match.
interactions.feedback: Nice match! Art time is planned for Wednesday.
interactions.retryHint: Find the day named in the question first, then choose art time.

interactions.prompt: Musa visits his grandmother on Sunday. Which sentence is true?
interactions.feedback: Correct! Musa's family visit is on Sunday.
interactions.retryHint: Say the day in the story again: Musa visits on ___.

interactions.prompt: Make a kind weekly plan. Tap Saturday, then tap help at home.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap Saturday, then tap help at home to make the plan.
interactions.feedback: Wonderful plan! Helping at home is a caring Saturday activity.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the day named first. Then choose the kind home activity.

interactions.prompt: Every day can have a useful activity. Why is a weekly plan helpful?
choices: It helps us know what to do on different days.
It makes every day have the same activity.
interactions.answer: It helps us know what to do on different days.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! A weekly plan helps us enjoy and prepare for different activities.
interactions.retryHint: Think about how a plan tells us what happens on each day.
